title: Strict henselization preserves Noetherianity of local rings
statement: Let $R$ be a local commutative ring and let $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. Then $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] if and only if $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is Noetherian.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), equivalence of conditions (1) and (3)

proof.text: Write $C=R^{\mathrm{sh}}$. By [lem-sc-strict-henselization-faithfully-flat], the canonical map $R\to C$ is faithfully flat.

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 06LJ: 'Since R -> R^h -> R^sh are faithfully flat (Lemma 07QM)'

proof.text: If $C$ is Noetherian, faithful-flat descent of Noetherianity [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-descent-noetherian] applied to $R\to C$ shows that $R$ is Noetherian.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ, proof: faithfully flat maps descend Noetherianity via Algebra Tag 033E

proof.text: Assume conversely that $R$ is Noetherian. By [lem-sc-strict-henselization-completion-noetherian], $\widehat C$ is Noetherian and $C\to\widehat C$ is faithfully flat. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-descent-noetherian] to this map gives that $C=R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ is Noetherian.
